content:
Maya S: Quick check-in for next week's webinar & launch post. Need a slim SEO preflight: keywords, JSON-LD, internal link touches, redirect mapping, and CRM routing.

Ravi K: Agree. Let's pick 3 priority keywords + 4 longtails. Also need meta descriptions and canonical tag for the landing.

Maya S: Priority keywords: "LLM inference platform", "production LLM serving", "inference cost optimization". Longtails: dedicated inference clusters, KV cache caching, continuous batching, model rollout strategy.

Tara L: I'll add minimal JSON-LD: WebPage + Event + 3 FAQ items. Will paste the Event snippet for the head and the FAQ for the body.

Devon P: Redirects: I'll prepare a CSV (source,target,code) and run 301s after publish. Sample rows I'll include: /old-webinar -> /events/serving-llms, /blog/2023/inference -> /events/serving-llms.

Ravi K: Internal links: PRs to add CTAs from /docs/runtime, /product/features, and /resources to the landing. Anchor variants: "low-latency serving", "reduce inference costs", "dedicated GPUs". I'll create the PRs.

Maya S: Inbound routing: pass utm params + webinar_id to CRM. Rule: company_size > 50 -> SDR; else -> nurture drip. Add field "interested_in" for SKU. @Devon confirm payload keys.

Devon P: Confirmed. Webhook payload: email, first_name, last_name, company, company_size (int), utm_source, utm_medium, utm_campaign, webinar_id, interested_in. Returns 200 on success.

Tara L: Messaging tests for signup modal: Variant A: "Ship LLM features with predictable latency" Variant B: "Lower inference cost without losing SLAs" Run 50/50 for first 1k viewers. Track CTR -> signup rate.

Maya S: Timeline: blog draft by Fri (1755570000), landing live Tue (1755635999), redirect sweep Tue night. Owners: Tara (schema/copy), Devon (redirects/webhook), Ravi (internal links), Maya (PM).

SEO-bot: Created task MARKETING-5120 "webinar landing SEO sweep" (https://trello.company/board/card/MARKETING-5120).

Maya S: I'll drop the draft link here when it's ready. Any issues?

Ravi K: All good from Eng. :thumbsup:
